svg.title: Shrimple
svg.desc: A tiny pixel-art shrimp that lives in your Windows system tray and reminds you to sit up straight. The tray icon is shown zoomed in: a calm shrimp standing upright in its patch of sea.

g.text: A tiny shrimp that reminds you to sit up straight.
No sounds. No pop-ups. Just a shrimp in your tray.
